description: This source file defines the code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page 'ExamResult'. It handles page load events to update user exam statistics in the database, display session-stored exam data, and navigate between pages via button clicks.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.ExamResult
classes.description: Partial class for the ExamResult page, inheriting from System.Web.UI.Page, handling page lifecycle events and user interactions for displaying and updating exam results.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves session data, updates user statistics in the database, and populates UI labels with exam data.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the LoginPage.
